parsed.rationale: Every member declared in `AudioPlayerProtocol` (`eventStream`, `installRenderTap`, `isPlaying`, `makeAudioBufferStream`, `play`, `removeRenderTap`, `state`, `stateStream`, `stop`) appears verbatim in `TimeShiftablePlayer`, which additionally declares time-shifting-specific members (`isAtLiveEdge`, `maxLookbackSeconds`, `secondsBehindLive`, `seek`, `seekToLive`, `timePositionStream`). This is a textbook subset relationship: `TimeShiftablePlayer` is a strict superset of `AudioPlayerProtocol`, both live in the same `Playback` package under `Shared/Playback/Sources/PlaybackCore/Protocols/`, and neither record carries any restraint flag. Making `TimeShiftablePlayer` inherit from `AudioPlayerProtocol` eliminates the nine duplicated member declarations, enforces the conceptual hierarchy (every time-shiftable player is-a audio player), and allows call sites that only need basic playback to accept any `AudioPlayerProtocol` without knowing about time-shifting.
